name: IT Standards Q&A
notes: Answers plain-English questions about a made-up sample IT Standards Portal of 12 standards with Yes, No or conditions verdicts tuned to the asker's role and links to each source clause, checks a proposed tool or project against the standards, and now opens with a worked example answer and proposal check, drafts a note to the standard owner when an answer is wrong or a gap is found, and swaps names, emails and phone numbers for placeholders before AI; assumes the real portal content and owner contacts replace the sample. Reviewed for the brief and manager ready.
desc: Ask a plain-English question about the IT standards and get a Yes, No or conditions answer with links to the exact clauses, or check a proposed tool or project against the standards. Wrong answers and gaps turn into a ready-to-send note for the standard's owner.
tested: Playwright at 1280x800 light and 390x844 dark: example answer and check render on load, Not right and Flag a gap draft an owner note, Copy answer, Copy check and Copy note to owner write to the clipboard and each has a Draft in Outlook link, chip questions and a not-covered question run in search-only mode, source links open the Standard tab, sample proposals run, tab arrow keys move focus, Steps to productionise opens, All AI prototypes shows, scrollWidth equals viewport, no dashes in visible text, no page or console errors. AI stand-in: names, emails and phones replaced by [name], [email], [phone] in both prompts, lower-case verdict normalised, grouped [S1, S2] citations split and out-of-range citations dropped, invalid proposal checks filtered.
